name: Frostfire Hot Springs
summary: Steam rises from Frostfire Hot Springs beneath the snow of western Winterspring. Curious scholars and hardy fishers come despite the cold, while hostile furbolgs keep near the pools.

sections.title: Steaming Waters in the Snow
sections.body: Near the tunnel to Timbermaw Hold, warm water runs beneath the snow at Frostfire Hot Springs. No one knows what keeps it hot. Winterfall furbolgs roam the banks, and their aggression makes the pools dangerous to approach. Fishers who brave the furbolgs and the winter chill find rare open water where fish thrive.

sections.title: A Geothermal Mystery
sections.body: The springs draw curious observers who wonder how their waters stay hot in this frozen land. Donova Snowden, an inquisitive dwarf, keeps a lonely vigil nearby as she studies their origin and composition. She suspects the heat may not be natural. Dark magic from the demonic stronghold of Darkwhisper Gorge could be seeping north and stirring the waters underground.

faq.q: Why are there hot springs in freezing Winterspring?
faq.answer: No one knows what heats the springs. Donova Snowden is investigating whether demonic influence from Darkwhisper Gorge may be involved.
Donova Snowden is a dwarven researcher camped near the hot springs. She studies their unusual properties and seeks travelers’ help in understanding Winterspring’s dangers.

faq.q: Could the springs be tied to demonic magic?
faq.answer: Donova Snowden suspects demonic corruption from Darkwhisper Gorge, far to the south, may run deep through the earth. It could heat or alter underground currents that rise at Frostfire Hot Springs.

faq.q: Who lives around the hot springs?
faq.answer: Aggressive Winterfall furbolgs hold territory near the springs and attack outsiders on sight. Stay alert around the pools.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may recognize your kin’s curiosity in Donova Snowden. She braves the frozen elements to study geological mysteries.
The springs’ unexplained warmth and unusual properties raise questions about the forces beneath Winterspring.
